description: This Java class 'EstabelecimentosDriver' provides methods for automated testing of web application functionality related to 'estabelecimentos' (establishments). It uses Selenium WebDriver to simulate user interactions such as navigating to a page, submitting forms, and verifying table contents.

classes.name: EstabelecimentosDriver
classes.description: A test utility class for automating web UI tests related to 'estabelecimentos' management.

methods.name: abreListagem
methods.description: Navigates the browser to the list page of establishments.

methods.name: adicioneEstabelecimento
methods.description: Fills out the form to add a new establishment with specified name and address, then submits the form.

methods.name: ultimaLinhaDeveConter
methods.description: Verifies that the last row in the table contains the specified name and address.

methods.name: deveMostrarErro
methods.description: Checks that the error message element contains the specified error string.

methods.name: adicioneEstabelecimentoComEstacionamento
methods.description: Adds an establishment with a specified parking availability (yes/no).

methods.name: ultimaLinhaDeveTerEstacionamento
methods.description: Verifies that the last table row indicates the parking availability.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Retrieves the form WebElement used for adding new establishments.

methods.name: ultimaLinha
methods.description: Retrieves the last row WebElement from the table.
